decision_authority: Erik Jones (ratified via merge of the pre-experiment readiness PR)
purpose: GI-16 attack-specification lockdown: one canonical artifact for the attack-strength values used by every confirmatory run. Values are restated, not invented — each was pre-registered in the experimental-design spec chain and is already encoded per-scenario in rmc/scenario_specs/S{0-4}.spec.json.

sources.alie_z_max_canonical: spec 2026-05-27 §4.2 'ALIE z_max canonical 0.9 (Szelag-exact)'; reaffirmed amendment v1.4 §5 'ALIE canonical strength z_max=0.9 is retained'
sources.alie_z_max_sensitivity: spec 2026-05-27 §4.2 'ALIE z_max sensitivity arm 0.5 (locked 2026-05-27)' and §6.2 sensitivity arm 'ALIE z=0.5'

notes: Sensitivity-arm runs are documented sensitivities, not required for any H1-H4 PASS decision (spec §6.2). Exploratory sweep outputs at other z values (signals/sweep_zmax*) are not pre-registered and must not be cited as confirmatory.
